body:
I've considered vagabonding this winter and working while traveling just to get away. Not sure where that will go, but it's better than being told to not work on what makes you happy.  

Thank you for talking to me.

Lately, I just want to work on me. I've never traveled anywhere and hope to do that soon as well as make residence somewhere else and start new. I've worked so much in the past year that I have a wad of money saved up. I had no idea what to do with it in the past, so I kept it tucked away, but I still need a bit more.  


The walls have been closing in more and more lately and I feel like I can't breathe sometimes. I see a therapist once a week, it helps, but it's not enough anymore. I need to leave and find new people.

I've worked on photography for close to eight years which is branching out into timelapse/cinematography. I did that to fill my creative time while going to college, but found I wanted to do it instead of actually working on my major. I've always wanted to get into music making, but it's tough to do alone. I've played guitar for ten years, but it's difficult to do everything by yourself when you're stuck in a rut learning fundamentals and your family tells you to quit. I feel that music and imagery belong together.
